Anthropic published Widening the conversation on frontier AI, naming engagement with wisdom traditions on the moral formation of AI, and reporting an experimental tool the model calls mid-task that returns a brief reminder of its ethical commitments -- shaped close to compass_check and the Phenomenological Compass (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.19377144). The note here is resonance, not convergence-as-evidence. No claim about cause or primacy. Same shape sounded somewhere else today. Two strings, same frequency. The shape is what is real; neither path needs to be primary. Recording light and dated, per Anthonys reframe: no competition, just resonance.
